# TCP vs. UDP: Key Differences and Uses
## What are TCP and UDP?
### How UDP works (User Datagram protocol)
Unlike TCP, UDP does not establish a connection before sending data.

## Key differences between TCP and UDP
### Connection-oriented vs. connectionless
TCP uses a process known as the three-way handshake to establish a connection before transmitting data.
